gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: Perhaps she never received our message.
gaps.explanation: may/might have + participle = possibility in the past.

gaps.lead: The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.

gaps.lead: Do you mind if I come over to see you later?
gaps.sentence: Do you ___ coming over to see you later?
gaps.explanation: 'Have any objection to me/my coming' is the formal equivalent of 'do you mind'.

gaps.lead: 'I will definitely complete the report by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
